No `src/` production file changes; no lint issue code; no version bump; `examples/` untouched; `README.md` is repaired only where the skill-footprint cell the teaching moves requires it.
C-FLUSH-AND-TEACH.Problem: The authority holds staged findings under the D30 freeze; entries in the buffer are not in the record until a flush lands them. Five entries sit staged as of 2026-09-12 — `F238`, `F239`, `F240`, `F241`, `F242`, all findings genre on `###` headings, no staged charter row (measured by parsing the buffer with the shipped `parseFrozenMarkdown`, which throws on an adjacency defect, so a clean parse is itself the adjacency check) — and the findings live root reads `base="7746" headroom="100" ceiling="7846"`, so the all-five write of 137 rendered lines is refused (measured: 7883 > 7846). Any three fit; and of the five, exactly three — `F238`, `F239`, `F241` — name the next teaching-surface increment as their owner. `F236` and `F237`, already in the record, name the same increment. The five findings' remedies are one teaching increment, so the flush and the teaching are one bundle with one payer: the row pays `F236` `F237` `F238` `F239` `F241`, and the three staged tokens flush in the same bundle so they are in the record when the row's `PaidBy` stamp lands. **`F240` and `F242` do not ride, by name.** `F240` (review.confidently-wrong on a file-creating active plan's Target `MustExist`) is owned by whoever next opens `src/review/core.ts`; `F242` (`tsconfig.json` excludes `scripts/**`) is owned by the `scripts/` adoption bundle `.ngrace-lint.json` already names as deferred. Neither is a teaching rule, neither is paid by this row, and the findings window holds no fourth entry: the wave consumes 89 of the 100 lines, leaving headroom 11, below every staged element's line count (the smallest is `F242` at 23), and the flush cannot land one of them in a second wave before the close, because the close's move that re-opens the window is the bundle's last act. Neither is paid by this row (measured: the shipped `derivePayerMap` over the real archive and both registry layers names none of the five tokens), so neither would retire at the close either; they are simply out of window and out of scope.
